title: Layers and properties
description: Create a layer, make it current and change an object's layer and colour.

steps.title: The Layers panel
steps.text: This panel lists every layer in the drawing. New objects go on the current layer, marked with a filled dot.

steps.title: Make a layer
steps.text: Click + and give the new layer a name.

steps.title: Make it current
steps.text: Click the empty circle beside the new layer to make it current. Anything you draw next will be on it.

steps.title: Select an object
steps.text: Choose the Select tool, then click an object in the drawing.

steps.title: Change layer and colour
steps.text: In Properties, use the Layer list to move the object to another layer, and the Colour list to change its colour.

steps.title: Filter the layers
steps.text: Type part of a layer name here to show only matching layers. Clear the box to see them all again.
